scope: Settings root, Account, Language & Region, Appearance, Notifications, Workspace Profile, Invites, machine list and machine detail across desktop and both locked mobile viewports

interactionEvidence.settingsHierarchy: the mobile root renders the personal/workspace menu and primary navigation; every setting detail hides primary navigation, exposes a 44x44 Back target, and returns to Settings
interactionEvidence.machineHierarchy: Settings opens /computer?from=settings as a detail-level machine list; machine details return to that list, then a second deterministic Back returns to Settings; neither level paints the primary bottom navigation
interactionEvidence.notificationReliability: a browser-only forced 503 produced a retryable alert and retry restored the real switch; a forced 403 on save rolled the draft back to false and rendered no Saved confirmation
interactionEvidence.machineDialog: the real Connect Computer wizard exposed a named aria-modal dialog, accepted Escape, restored focus to the exact + trigger, and removed the temporary offline machine created during the cancelled flow
interactionEvidence.responsiveMatrix: Account, Language & Region, Appearance, Notifications, Workspace Profile, and Invites measured zero horizontal overflow at both 390x844 and 375x812
interactionEvidence.localPreferences: language and appearance are device-local settings and never claim a server mutation; Account, Notifications, Workspace Profile, Invites and Machines keep their real APIs

permissionEvidence.workspace: editing and avatar upload require manageServer; members receive disabled fields and explicit read-only copy, while the API independently enforces the capability
permissionEvidence.invites: manageMembers gates the complete surface and the join-link endpoints remain authoritative for list/create/delete
permissionEvidence.machines: manageMachines gates add, reconnect, update guidance and delete; machine identity, runtime, status, Agent binding and daemon contracts are not changed
permissionEvidence.failures: all settings writes inspect error envelopes before success state; Account and Workspace retain the editable draft for retry, Notifications roll back, and Invite mutations retain the current list

intentionalDifferences: OpenTag keeps its real Account fields and authentication model; it does not copy Raft-only connected-account, password-email, billing, marketplace, or hosted MCP operations.
OpenTag keeps invitation management in a focused page instead of copying Raft's broader Administration console, because only join-link operations exist in the current backend contract.
OpenTag preserves real machine keys, daemon versions, runtime discovery, Agent bindings and capability gates instead of copying private Raft machine data or commands.
Classic remains unchanged as the immediate rollback surface.
